closure: Solio closed 1-15 Nov 2026 inclusive (dates flexible, confirm with reservations).

rates.unit: fully inclusive (all meals, drinks, game drives, laundry, most excursions)

familyCottage.note: Up to 2 adults & 2 children sharing, minimum room rate.

childRateLogic.note: Two distinct child rates depending on rooming, per page 20/10 of source — do not conflate them.
childRateLogic.perChildRate: Applies when: two children sharing a room (rate applies to each child), OR a child sharing with exactly one adult.
childRateLogic.perChildSharingExtraBed: Applies when a child aged 3-11 is the 3rd person in a room with two others (adults or children) on an extra bed. Our itinerary's 2-adults-plus-1-child case uses THIS rate.

conservationFees.note: Subject to change per Solio Ranch/local councils.

professionalGuideRoom.unit: per person per night, exclusive of conservation fees

transferInclusions.note: IMPORTANT for itinerary planning: rate INCLUDES transfers from Solio and Nanyuki Airstrips (both directions implied). Rate EXCLUDES road transfers (i.e., overland connections to/from other, non-airstrip locations, e.g. onward to Samburu).
transferInclusions.accessByAir: Daily scheduled flights from Nairobi into Nanyuki Airstrip, then 20-min transfer to conservancy gate + 45-min to lodge (all included). Private charter into Solio Ranch's own airstrip: 10-min transfer to lodge (included).
transferInclusions.accessByRoad: 4-hour drive from Nairobi on a good road.

roomNote: 5 individual cottages, the 5th is a Family unit (2 en-suite bedrooms, up to 5 people). Minimum stay: 2 nights.
childPolicyGeneral: Children aged 3-15 years 364 days. 16+ is adult. Infants (0-2y 364d) stay free.
